description: This file defines the class 'ContactOpportunityRelationship' which models a relationship between contacts and opportunities within the SuiteCRM platform. It manages fields related to the contact-opportunity link, provides methods for filling in related details, and extends the SugarBean base class.

classes.name: ContactOpportunityRelationship
classes.description: Represents a relationship record linking a contact and an opportunity, including related fields and methods to populate additional details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets up database connections.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates contact_name and opportunity_name fields by querying related tables using contact_id and opportunity_id.
